symbol_normalizations.notes: TD prints the same short 20-contract CALL lot (strike 34.00, expiry 2027-01-15, x100 multiplier) under the adjusted root 5SOXS through the June 2026 statement and under SOXS1 from July 2026; quantity and book value are identical across the two months and no activity row was printed for the symbol change. TD WebBroker 58MRB0-USD July 2026 statement, holdings section (SOXS1 line)
